paragraphs: I am applying for the Software Engineer role at Theodo. My work has focused on building software that helps people carry out complex tasks, from campaign setup to security competitions.

At Hypeo, I integrated an AI agent experience that turns client conversations into configured marketing campaigns using an internal influencer database. Working closely with a senior technical lead, I refined the front-end experience as the backend integration and business requirements evolved.

At Cyber Cohesion, I led web development for a security competition platform used at events including OWASP AppSec Days and BSides Singapore. I also developed its Warzone dashboard, which tracks team progress and scores.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience could support the work at Theodo. Thank you for your consideration.
